Bottom line: Tighten risk management on leveraged positions and stay nimble ahead of macro data.
plays: Adjust SOXL's stop loss from 200 to a relevant level; its -48.51% drawdown and leveraged decay need immediate attention.
Review SPAL's stop loss at 21.38; its -46.25% loss and leveraged nature demand tight risk management.
